summary: Per-store Twilio texting compliance (A2P 10DLC + CNAM) admin API + web UI reviewed end-to-end. Backend: existing pytest test_twilio_compliance.py stays 4/4 green; wrote 17 new integration tests against the preview REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exercising every review requirement (overview, settings mode + notify_email + validation, options, GET/PUT record, blank-EIN preservation, CNAM normalization, dry-run submit->check lifecycle to complete/approved, reset RBAC for user/manager/super_admin, missing-fields 400, unsigned Trust Hub webhook, scheduler poll_all coroutine). All 21 tests pass. Frontend: logged in as forest (super_admin) by seeding token in localStorage, navigated /admin/compliance via history.pushState. Header + 4 stat boxes + mode chips + blurb + notify email + save + store rows all render with correct testIDs; switching to 'Twilio mock' updates the blurb and persists across reload; save/clear notify email works; navigation to /admin/compliance/{QA} shows the timeline, business/rep/campaign/CNAM forms, save + submit; after submit the in-review note + Check now button + reset button appear and multiple Check now clicks advance the timeline (Business profile / A2P / Brand all approved). Final state restored: mode dry_run, notify_email '', QA store stage draft.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/compliance.py:88 - GET /{store_id} returns EIN-masked record but also sets `rec['numbers'] = ...` on a possibly-None `rec` after `defaults(store)`; safe today because defaults() always returns a dict, worth an explicit setdefault for clarity.
services/twilio_compliance.py:415 - `rec['numbers'] = numbers` inside advance() overwrites what public() returned; consumers reading `record.numbers` via GET get this list correctly. No bug.

services/twilio_compliance.py CNAM branch (~L489) runs on every advance() step including the campaign stage; harmless in dry_run but in live mode causes an extra CNAM create call the moment customer_profile is approved. Intentional per docstring ('CNAM rides alongside once the business profile is approved') but worth a status-callback verification pass before going live.

routers/compliance.py:31 - super_admin bypass path returns immediately, but org_admin path only allows access when `str(store.organization_id) == str(me.organization_id)` — good; store_manager role correctly gets 403 (confirmed by test).
